structured_output.summary: The change is small and mostly faithful. Step 2 (RequireInternalSlot) throws a TypeError for non-objects and for objects without [[ArrayBufferData]], and step 4 calls IsDetachedBuffer. Step 3 (IsSharedArrayBuffer -> TypeError) is not implemented. The code asserts it is always false via a comment and never calls a shared-buffer check or throws not_implemented. That is a shortcut standing in for a spec step, so I flag it as made_up_results. The rest of the diff is clean.

problems.issue: Spec step 3 (If IsSharedArrayBuffer(obj) is true, throw a TypeError) is dropped. The code has no check at all. The comment asserts that the engine has no Shared Data Block representation, so the step is treated as always false. That claim is not verified in the diff, and the ticket asks for ops helpers to be used rather than re-implemented. The fix is to call the shared-buffer check (or add the TypeError path for shared buffers if such a representation exists). If no such helper exists, return agent.not_implemented("IsSharedArrayBuffer") rather than assuming the answer.
